result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks and a marked crosswalk at a commercial intersection. However, safety is limited by faded pavement markings, a lack of active traffic control, and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the Velez Agency building

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: There are no visible stop signs or signals for the primary direction of travel at this crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows an urban street with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. The environment includes trolley tracks embedded in the roadway and parked vehicles that may obstruct sight lines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Tracks in the roadway can cause tripping or slipping, especially for those with mobility aids or in wet conditions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the crosswalk limit the visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

result.summary: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being controlled by traffic lights. The presence of trolley tracks and significantly degraded pavement creates tripping hazards and a generally hostile environment for pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and overhead traffic signals in a mixed-use urban environment. However, the presence of embedded trolley tracks and degraded pavement creates tripping hazards, and there are no visible dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and create a tripping hazard for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway crossing the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and potholes in the asphalt adjacent to the trolley tracks within the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and left side of the intersection

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection may block the visibility of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate tripping hazards and improve the walking surface within the crosswalk area.
